integrity: Proof depends on Fantechi–Göttsche Theorem 4.25 and 6.6, Cherednik's punctual-cell result, Göttsche H1 invariance and Roitman's torsion theorem; numerical examples are consistency checks only.
scientific_limitations: Complex smooth projective surfaces; integral CSM identities require vanishing irregularity. Ordinary zero-cycle Chow only. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Integral Chow–Euler identities for symmetric powers of irregularity-zero surfaces
